F.name: C light + A dark, soft cosmic background
F.note: Light theme from option C, dark theme from option A. A faint cosmic glow sits in the page background; the message box itself has no glow.

light.glow: radial-gradient(70% 55% at 50% 42%, #7fb2ff2e, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(45% 40% at 78% 18%, #6fe0d01f, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 40% at 18% 85%, #a9b8ff1f, transparent 70%)

dark.glow: radial-gradient(70% 55% at 50% 40%, #5b8cff26, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(45% 40% at 80% 15%, #3fd0c016, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 40% at 15% 88%, #8f9bff18, transparent 70%)
